description: Where a Lean declaration of a claim is declared, under exactly its full name — each file the code index finds declaring its last part is read at the indexed commit and its namespaces, sections and _root_ resolved, so a namesake in another namespace is no place. Searched in the project's repositories that are open to its agents: the repository, the file, the line, the line's text, the commit the index is at, and 'sorry' for a statement whose proof is a sorry (never bound). The best place first — a proof before a sorry, then the file whose folders follow the name's namespace; 'ambiguous' when several proofs answer. Pass the full name, e.g. 'D5.rank5_decided'. Then bind a claim's basis to it with set_claim, {"kind":"lean","ref":"D5.rank5_decided","repo":"ispacex/d5","path":"D5/Rank5.lean"}. 'unread' names files that could not be read to check. Members of the project who may write only.

repo.description: Look in this repository only, by its path, e.g. 'ispacex/d5'.
